subject: FW: Vessel offer — MV PACIFIC PEARL / Novorossiysk–Mersin
body:
Dear Partners,

Please find below vessel offer for your consideration:

VESSEL: MV PACIFIC PEARL
IMO: 9876543
FLAG: Panama
DWT: 28,500
BUILT: 2009

OPEN: Novorossiysk, 20 April 2026
LAYCAN: 22–26 April 2026

CARGO INTEREST: Steel coils / bulk grain, 25,000–28,000 MT
ROUTE: Novorossiysk → Mersin (TR)

Owner: Pacific Pearl Navigation Ltd
Broker: Black Sea Chartering LLC

Please revert with your cargo interest at earliest.

Best regards,
Ops Desk
